QuestInfo.name: [Fame] What Do Stars Live For?
QuestInfo.1:
Stars live a fast and fabulous life, but even they are vulnerable sometimes. Valerie could use some support, so get her Encouragement Placards from monsters.


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Encouragement Placards, unless they are level 150 or higher.
QuestInfo.2: What do stars live for? The fans, of course!

0.0: So, how's the fan club going, #b#h0##k? I guess you heard that #rValerie#k has been having a hard time lately. I mean, the life of a star may be glamorous and all, but behind all the glitz, they can get really lonely sometimes. You think you could help me cheer her up?

yes.0: See, here's the problem. I made 5 placards with inspirational phrases and stuff for her, but monsters stole them all. #rHunt normal monsters#k in Maple World, and find #ball 5 Encouragement Placards#k. And, when you give them to her, put your heart into it, okay?
yes.1: Just so you know, #rmonsters that are 11 levels higher or lower than your level#k probably don't have the placards, so go after ones near your level. I'm sure #bValerie#k is waiting for you, so good luck!

no.0: Wow, really? You're just going to let her suffer through her fame and adoration all by herself?

npc.0: Take it to Valerie, not to me!

item.0: Hello, #b#h0##k. Did you have something for me? I don't see anything...
